## How to reproduce

Three steps, run from `inference/k8s_recipes/`. Nothing else is needed — `install` provisions the cluster side and `run` drives the whole lifecycle.

```bash
# 1 · pick your cluster → writes cluster-profiles/<profile>.env  (one-time, per cluster)
scripts/llmb-k8s init

# 2 · install THIS recipe: namespace + secrets + model-cache PVC + weights  (safe to re-run)
scripts/llmb-k8s install <profile> --recipes glm5-1k1k-hightpt-dynamo14-c2576-1p1d

# 3 · run it: preflight → serve → sweep → results (GPUs freed on the way out)
scripts/llmb-k8s run recipes/llm-perf/Glm5/B200_k8s/Disagg/sglang_dynamo/1k_1k/glm5-fp8-b200-sglang-dynamo14-1k1k-hightpt-c2576-1p1d <profile> --teardown --fetch
```

### …or run the whole group (6 cells)

This cell is one of a family — same `llm-perf` · `pareto` · `synthetic` benchmark on the same `B200` hardware, at different points. Steps 1–3 above do one point; these do the family. Same three verbs.
